front: Sense through roots to detect unnoticed creatures nearby and get a bonus to Seek and Track them.
back:
30-foot emanation. Learn of unnoticed Medium or larger creatures there; they're undetected to you. You may immediately Seek an undetected creature.
+1 status bonus to that Seek and your other Seeks for hidden/undetected creatures until end of your next turn.
Also learn if such creatures passed through in the last hour (vague direction).
+1 status bonus to the initial Track check on a creature detected this way.
